title: The fixed rule on net1 v3 and v4: choosing u on validation links
description: The fixed rule (window = 2^u times net1's believed BDP) on net1 v4 (the run chosen in exp-net1v4-grid-10), on net1 v3 (model-net1v3) and on the true BDP, each for u in {-0.25, 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5}, with BBRv3 as the reference, on the validation links: the training conditions at 20 s and 60 s, and the new, deep-long and cubic-first families (experiments/heldout.py), campaign seed 11. Each group's u is the one with the best mean difference from BBRv3 over the five campaigns (chosen.json); the test links are not touched.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; U="-0.25 0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u $U; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v3" "$IN/models/net1v3.pt" --u $U; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/oracle" "$IN/models/net1v3.pt" --u $U --oracle; P=(); for u in $U; do P+=(--policy "v4-u$u=$OUT/v4/rule-u$u.onnx" --policy "v3-u$u=$OUT/v3/rule-u$u.onnx" --policy "oracle-u$u=$OUT/oracle/rule-u$u-oracle.onnx"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --select v4 v3 oracle
